summary.headline: KUMHO Engineering & Construction amends KRW 206.5bn Gongju gas power plant contract
summary.what_happened: KUMHO Engineering & Construction Co., Ltd. filed a corrected disclosure for a single supply contract for the Gongju Natural Gas Power Plant construction project, signed with Korea Western Power Co., Ltd. The correction, made on Nov 27, 2026 and related to a change in the subcontract, raised the contract amount from KRW 202.5bn to KRW 206.6bn, and raised the total project contract amount from KRW 289.3bn to KRW 295.1bn (VAT included). The company's construction share is 70% of the total project.

key_numbers.label: Total project contract amount (corrected, VAT incl.)

summary.why_it_matters: In Korea, corrected supply contract disclosures usually indicate that previously reported contract values or terms have been revised, which can affect how investors read the scale of a company's order backlog and expected revenue. Contract amounts may also change over the project period due to design changes or other business conditions.
